decision: GIANT CELLS is the final SiderAtlas No.006; no movie or scientific-model change required
review_method: Read actual implementation; eight full statistical maps and direct spectral/angular checks; full960-frame decode and65epoch storyboard;31consecutive critical encoded frames; actual179–180 limb remeasurement
critical_interval_findings: Continuous statistically evolving cells with unchanged birth sizes; visible contrast changes follow Teff, spectral sensitivity, cell statistics and geometric projection; no giant-atlas zoom or model handoff in these intervals
caveat: Internally consistent physics-informed numerical visualization, not validated giant RHD or an observation
